optimizedDescription.value: Report SDK graph health and coverage diagnostics with config/bootstrap semantics, structured output, and provider-owned errors.

optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Stats
## Rules
- `specd graph stats [--config <path> | --path <path>] [--format text|json|toon]`; options exclusive; default format `text`.
- `--config`: valid outside VCS; unavailable VCS health remains provider data. `--path` / no-config fallback: bootstrap only, require VCS.
- Use `openSpecdHost` resolved config + kernel workspace definitions; `withOpenGraphProvider`; call `getGraphHealth` exactly once. Never independently discover workspaces/recompute/merge health, or pre-open lock probe.
- Text: labeled counts + aggregate/global stale/content freshness/coverage/schema-generation/non-current-workspace/stable reason-code diagnostics; dirty/partial/unknown/incompatible never unqualified fresh/current; explain inability to prove symbol absence.
- JSON/TOON: full unchanged `getGraphHealth`; legacy `stale`, `currentRef`, `fingerprintMismatch` may remain.
- `GRAPH_BUSY`, `GRAPH_PROVIDER_STALE`, provider/open/retrieval infrastructure failures: exit 3.
## Constraints
- SDK owns provider lifecycle/health orchestration; explicit `process.exit(0)` after wrapper close.
- Text omits zero relation counts; no CLI pre-open lock probe.
